metronidazole.t: Monitor for neurologic toxicities in patients receiving metronidazole.
Effect of Cyclophosphamide on Other Drugs Metronidazole Acute encephalopathy has been reported in a patient receiving cyclophosphamide and metronidazole.

tamoxifen.t: Tamoxifen Concomitant use of tamoxifen and a cyclophosphamide-containing chemotherapy regimen may increase the risk of thromboembolic complications.
Monitor for signs and symptoms of thromboembolic events in patients receiving tamoxifen.

warfarin.t: Coumarins Both increased and decreased warfarin effect have been reported in patients receiving warfarin and cyclophosphamide.
Monitor anticoagulant activity closely in patients receiving warfarin or other coumarins.

anticoag.t: Monitor anticoagulant activity closely in patients receiving warfarin or other coumarins.

qt.t: Supraventricular arrhythmias (including atrial fibrillation and flutter) and ventricular arrhythmias (including severe QT prolongation associated with ventricular tachyarrhythmia) have been reported after treatment with regimens that included cyclophosphamide.
